description: This Kotlin source file defines the MqttClientManager class, which manages MQTT client connections using HiveMQ's MQTT library. It provides functionality to connect, subscribe, publish, and disconnect from an MQTT broker, and exposes flows for connection status and incoming messages.

classes.name: MqttClientManager
classes.description: Class managing MQTT client connection, subscription, publishing, and message flow handling using HiveMQ MQTT library in Kotlin.

methods.name: connectAndSubscribe
methods.description: Establishes connection to MQTT broker and subscribes to specified topics.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Publishes a message to a specified MQTT topic with given QoS and retain flag.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the MQTT client from the broker.
